title: Channels
subtitle: {{brand}} · how customers reach this brand

mailboxes.heading: Mailboxes
mailboxes.caption_one: {{count}} address · incoming only; mail to it opens tickets in its department
mailboxes.caption_other: {{count}} addresses · incoming only; mail to each opens tickets in its department

empty.heading: No mailboxes yet
empty.body: Add the address customers write to, and mail sent to it opens tickets.

replies.heading: Replies go out once per brand
replies.body: A mailbox only receives. The SMTP server, the From and Reply-To for each department, auto-replies and failed sends are on

legend.heading: Health
legend.healthy: Healthy: the last poll or delivery worked.
legend.behind: Behind: no successful poll for 3 intervals.
legend.failing: Failing: the server refused sign-in or cannot be reached.
legend.waiting: Waiting: an inbound-parse mailbox that has not received mail yet.

inboundParse.heading: Inbound parse endpoints
inboundParse.caption: For providers that post incoming mail to Helpdock instead of being polled. The recipient address picks the mailbox.
inboundParse.hint: Requests without it are refused. Shown once when replaced, never again.
inboundParse.noSecret: No secret is set, so every request is refused until you set one.

confirm.title: Replace the shared secret?
confirm.body: Providers still using the current secret are refused from the moment you replace it. Update each provider with the new one straight away.

reveal.title: Copy the new secret
reveal.body: This is the only time it is shown. Give it to each provider as the X-Helpdock-Inbound-Secret header, or as the password in the endpoint URL.
reveal.label: New shared secret

deleteConfirm.title: Delete {{address}}?
deleteConfirm.body: Mail sent to this address stops opening tickets. Tickets it already opened stay where they are.

address.heading: Address and routing
address.caption: Where mail sent to this address lands. Replies go out through the brand’s outgoing mail, not this mailbox.
address.displayNameHint: Shown to customers as the sender name.
address.departmentHint: Replies to an existing ticket stay in that ticket’s department.

incoming.heading: Incoming mail
incoming.caption: How Helpdock collects mail sent to this address.
incoming.imapHint: Helpdock signs in and fetches new mail.
incoming.parseHint: Your provider posts mail to an endpoint listed on Channels › Mailboxes.
incoming.passwordSaved: Saved {{date}} by {{name}}. Never shown again after saving.
incoming.passwordSavedBySomeone: Saved {{date}}. Never shown again after saving.

test.hint: Signs in with the values on screen, saved or not. Nothing is imported.

ok.title: Connected to {{host}}:{{port}}
ok.body: {{folder}} has {{messages}} messages, {{unseen}} unread. Nothing was imported.

auth.title: IMAP refused the sign-in
auth.hint: Check the username and the password; many providers need an app password, not the account password.

connect.title: Could not reach {{host}}:{{port}}
connect.body: Check the host, the port and that the server accepts connections from this install.

timeout.title: Could not reach {{host}}:{{port}}
timeout.body: No answer within 15 s. Check the host, the port and that the server accepts connections from this install.

folder.title: No folder called {{folder}} on {{host}}
folder.body: Check the folder name; most servers treat it as case-sensitive.

security.heading: Security
security.caption: Applies to mail received by this mailbox. Scripts, forms and styles outside the allowlist are always removed.
security.block: Block until an agent loads them
security.blockHint: Agents see a “Remote images blocked” bar with Load images. Tracking pixels never fire on their own.
security.proxy: Load through the Helpdock image proxy
security.proxyHint: Shown at once, fetched by the server, so the sender never sees an agent’s address or browser.
security.spf: Treat SPF or DKIM failures as possible spam
security.spfHint: The ticket opens in the Spam view instead of the queue.
security.allowlist: Automated senders that may open tickets
security.allowlistHint: One address per line. Other automated mail (Auto-Submitted, bulk, noreply@) is logged and never opens a ticket.

footer.unsaved: Unsaved changes · the mailbox keeps polling with its saved settings until you save.

errors.password: An IMAP mailbox needs a password

notFound.heading: No such mailbox
notFound.body: It may have been deleted. Go back to the list and pick another.

refusal.address-taken: Another mailbox already receives mail for that address.
refusal.password-required: Enter the IMAP password: none is stored for this mailbox yet.
refusal.department-not-found: That department no longer exists. Pick another.

toast.failed: That did not work. Try again.

loadFailed: Outgoing email could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
actionFailed: That did not work. Nothing was changed.

smtp.heading: Outgoing mail (SMTP)
smtp.caption: One server for the whole brand. Every reply, CC copy and auto-reply goes through it. DKIM is signed by your provider.
smtp.installFallback: This brand has no server of its own yet and sends through the install's, set in the first-run wizard.
smtp.noServer: No server is configured, so no email can be sent until one is saved here.

testFailed.auth-failed: The SMTP server refused the sign-in
testFailed.connection-refused: Could not reach the SMTP server
testFailed.tls-error: The secure connection could not be set up
testFailed.timeout: The SMTP server did not answer in time
testFailed.rejected: The SMTP server refused the message
testFailed.unknown: The test message was not sent

senders.heading: From and Reply-To per department
senders.caption: A reply, CC copy or auto-reply goes out as the ticket's department.
senders.defaultHint: Used by departments not listed below.
senders.warning: A From address must be one your SMTP provider lets you send as, or mail may be rejected or land in spam.
senders.invalid: Write it as Name <address@example.com>, or just the address.
senders.replyToInvalid: Enter an email address, or leave it empty.

autoReplies.heading: Auto-replies
autoReplies.caption: For the whole brand. Sent from the ticket's department sender, in the contact's language, else the brand's default.
autoReplies.acknowledgmentHint: Sent once when an email opens a new ticket. Carries the ticket reference so the customer's reply threads.
autoReplies.outOfHoursHint: Sent instead of the acknowledgment when mail arrives outside the department's business hours.
autoReplies.hoursNote: Uses Ticketing › Business hours. With none set, every hour counts as open and this is never sent.
autoReplies.loopBody: Auto-replies carry Auto-Submitted: auto-replied and are never sent to mail marked Auto-Submitted or Precedence: bulk / list, or to noreply@ and mailer-daemon@ senders.
autoReplies.capAfter: auto-replies to one sender per hour. Mail past the cap still opens or updates tickets.
autoReplies.capLabel: Auto-replies to one sender per hour

template.title: {{kind}} · {{language}}
template.subject: Subject
template.placeholders: Placeholders: {{list}}. Plain text. Header, reference line and footer are added.
template.required: Enter a subject and a body.

failed.heading: Failed sends
failed.caption: Replies the mail server refused {{attempts}} times. Nothing is retried until you choose.
failed.note: Retry sends the same message with the same Message-ID, so a customer never receives it twice. Discard leaves the reply on the ticket marked Not delivered.
failed.empty: No failed sends. Every reply was delivered or is still being retried.
failed.retriedAll: Every failed send went back to the queue.
failed.discarded: Discarded. The reply stays on the ticket, marked Not delivered.

widget.loadFailed: The widget settings could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

embed.heading: Embed code
embed.caption: Paste it before </body> on each page that should show the widget. The page's origin must be in Allowed origins below.
embed.label: Embed code
embed.hint: The widget follows the page's lang; add data-locale="ar" to force Arabic.
embed.protocol: Native apps use the same protocol:

appearance.heading: Appearance
appearance.caption: Mode and look. The preview updates as you change them; visitors see them once saved.

chat.label: Chat
chat.hint: Visitors write to your team. With nobody online it switches to the contact form.

chat_articles.label: Chat and suggested articles
chat_articles.hint: Suggests articles while the visitor types, before they send. Until help center search arrives it offers the most-read articles.

helpcenter.label: Help center
helpcenter.hint: Search and browse articles inside the widget. A Contact us link opens the form.

form.label: Contact form
form.hint: No live chat. Visitors leave a message that becomes a ticket.

appearance.contrastPass: White text on it: {{ratio}} : 1, passes. Below 3 : 1 is refused.
appearance.contrastFail: White text on it: {{ratio}} : 1. Below 3 : 1 is refused; choose a darker colour.
appearance.schemeHint: Auto follows the visitor's system setting.
appearance.launcherHint: With text, it reads “Chat with us” in the visitor's language.
appearance.greetingHint: The greeting is the first message a visitor sees. An empty Arabic greeting falls back to the English one.

preview.heading: Live preview
preview.caption: Unsaved changes included. Shown with the pre-chat form on and an agent online.
preview.replies: Usually replies in a few minutes
preview.name: Name

conversation.heading: Conversation
conversation.caption: What visitors see before, during and after a chat.
conversation.prechat: Ask for details before the first message
conversation.prechatHint: An email typed here is not verified. Agents see an Unverified badge, and it never opens the visitor's other conversations.
conversation.fieldsHint: Fields come from Ticketing › Custom fields. Answers are saved on the ticket.
conversation.agent: Show the agent's name and photo
conversation.agentHint: When an agent joins, visitors see their first name and avatar.
conversation.unavailableKeep: Keep chat open and say when we reply
conversation.unavailableHint: Outside business hours, or when no agent is online. Hours are set in Ticketing › Business hours.
conversation.transcriptHint: When the chat ends, visitors can have it sent to the address they typed. The email holds this conversation only, with no link back into it.

policy.heading: What visitors can send
policy.caption: Each kind on or off, with a size cap and the file types allowed. Admins and Team Leaders.
policy.videoHint: Stored as sent, poster frame made
policy.voiceHint: Recorded in the browser, stored as Opus
policy.tooLarge: Above this install's upload limit of {{limit}} MB.
policy.badSize: Enter a whole number of MB, 1 or more.
policy.badTypes: Enter MIME types like image/png, separated by commas.
policy.perMessageHint: Uploads are checked by their content, not their name. Anything else is refused before it is stored.
policy.badPerMessage: Enter a whole number from 0 to {{max}}.

access.heading: Where the widget may run
access.caption: Requests from any other site are refused: the config, the visitor sign-in and the live connection.
access.badOrigin: Enter an origin only: scheme and host, like https://shop.helpdock.com. No path.
access.originsHint: With no origins the widget loads nowhere. Visitors are also throttled per visitor and per IP address.
access.captcha: Check for bots before the first message
access.captchaHint: Visitors pass one challenge per conversation. The provider's script is loaded only while this is on.
access.secretSaved: Saved {{date}} by {{name}}. The web form uses the same keys.
access.secretSavedBySystem: Saved {{date}}. The web form uses the same keys.
access.noSecret: No secret saved yet. The web form uses the same keys.
access.needsKeys: Enter a site key and a secret key to switch the check on.

signed.heading: Signed identity
signed.caption: Your site vouches for a signed-in user, so they keep their widget conversations across devices.
signed.enabled: Accept signed identity from your site
signed.enabledHint: Your server signs the user id and a timestamp with this secret (HMAC-SHA256). Signatures older than 5 minutes are refused. A bad signature leaves the visitor anonymous and is logged.
signed.secretCreated: Created {{date}} by {{name}}. Replacing it stops signatures made with the old one at once.
signed.secretCreatedBySystem: Created {{date}}. Replacing it stops signatures made with the old one at once.
signed.noSecret: No signing secret yet. Replace makes one.
signed.copyNow: Copy it now and put it on your server. It will not be shown again.
signed.allChannels: Signed-in visitors also see their email and Telegram tickets
signed.allChannelsHint: Off by default. When off, a verified visitor sees only their widget conversations.
signed.guide: How to sign: widget protocol guide
